MULTIPLAYER
Play with friends: one player opens their world (pause menu, Open to Friends) and shares the 6-letter code.
CONTROLS
Click a key, then press the new key (Esc cancels). Hotbar keys are always 1-9. Double-tap forward to sprint, or to swim underwater.
MODS
Mods add blocks, items, recipes, world generation and new rules. A mod runs code inside your game, so only add mods from people you trust.
